long_biography.plain_text:
Eduard Khudainatov's long energy career developed through a succession of operating roles. He led Severneftegazprom before joining Rosneft, where he moved from vice-president to first vice-president and president. Those posts placed him in senior management of major oil and gas production businesses.

After leaving Rosneft, Khudainatov became president of Independent Oil and Gas Company and expanded its asset base through acquisitions and partnerships. The group brought together exploration, production, refining and fuel distribution, shifting his role from managing established producers to building an integrated private business across the energy chain.
